name: kernels-draft

tests.note: the Mini's 10 tests (mini_drafter::, incl. the oracle planes on the long and real_chat-capital-effort0 cases, golden hashes, graph replay) and the Small's 11 on the Small's real pack (golden hashes unchanged); the ignored test is the Small's benchmark; the Small's two oracle tests print 'not run' (no Small oracle fixtures)

<lab>/venv/bin/python oracle/gen_dspark_fixtures.py --pack <Mini pack> --fixtures none --out fix/dspark --threads 8 --only long   (node-1, CPU, niced)
<lab>/venv/bin/python oracle/gen_real_case.py --pack <Mini pack> --fixtures fix --out fix/dspark --name chat-capital-effort0 --anchors 1,5,13,24,25,26,30,33,39   (node-1, CPU, niced)
REXL3_NO_CUDA=1 cargo test -p gb-model --lib --locked families::inkling2::   (the Mac)
